description: A live waterfall/trace view in Conan that visualizes Claude Code subagent spawns as lanes on a time axis — DevTools-network style, not project-management gantt. MVP scope: flat (non-nested) live bars inside the existing per-terminal Timeline split panel, Premium-gated.

userStories.title: Give SubagentStop a proper Timeline row instead of a generic EVENT fallthrough
userStories.description: As a user watching the Timeline, I want a SubagentStop hook to render as a clearly-labeled 'subagent finished' row instead of a generic, unhelpful 'EVENT: SubagentStop' row, so the classic feed isn't noisy even before Agent Lanes exists.
acceptanceCriteria: mapHookEventToRow (src/timeline/index.ts:219-318) gets a `case "SubagentStop":` branch instead of falling through to the generic `default` case at line 301-304

Verified live payload shape (audited against this machine's real .data/conan.db, 59 SubagentStop rows): fields are `agent_id`, `agent_type` (often an empty string — do not assume it's populated), `agent_transcript_path`, `last_assistant_message`, `stop_hook_active`. There is NO `tool_use_id` field on SubagentStop — do not attempt to pair it against PreToolUse/PostToolUse by tool-use id

Row title is descriptive (e.g. 'Subagent finished'); when `last_assistant_message` is a non-empty string, surface it truncated (~160 chars, matching the existing `truncate()` helper) as the row's `detail`, same pattern SessionEnd already uses for its `reason` field
This story does NOT need to touch `parent_tool_use_id` — it is unrelated to this row's classification
Add a test case to src/timeline/index.test.ts asserting a SubagentStop hook event row maps to the new title/detail shape, not the generic 'event' default
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Pair Agent spawn start/end events into bar records (backend)
userStories.description: As the gateway, I need to derive one bar record per subagent spawn (start time, end time or still-running, duration, token/tool-call totals) from the raw PreToolUse/PostToolUse event history, so the UI has ready-made data to render as a waterfall instead of raw hook rows.
acceptanceCriteria: IMPORTANT — corrected PRD assumption, verified against live data: the subagent-spawn tool is named `"Agent"` in this environment's hook payloads, NOT `"Task"` as the source PRD assumed. Match on `tool_name === "Agent"` (or `payload.tool_name`), not `"Task"`

New function (e.g. `deriveAgentSpawns(sessionId, events)` in src/timeline/index.ts, alongside the existing `readSessionSkillFirings`/`readSessionPlans` derivations) scans a session's PreToolUse/PostToolUse events where tool_name is 'Agent'

Pairs PreToolUse('Agent')/PostToolUse('Agent') by `payload.tool_use_id` — verified present and matching on BOTH events for every real Agent-tool pair audited in .data/conan.db (this also matches the sibling prd-timeline-rollup.md's independent audit finding). Do NOT implement an order-based fallback for MVP — it's unverified and unnecessary given id-based pairing works reliably

IMPORTANT — corrected PRD assumption: `parent_tool_use_id` is the column the PRD describes as 'populated on ingest' for subagent nesting, but a live audit found it is NEVER populated (0 of 1000+ real event rows had a non-empty value). Do not build pairing or nesting logic on top of it — MVP's flat (non-nested) bar list sidesteps this entirely since it only needs tool_use_id

Each bar record: `{ toolUseId, startedAt, endedAt: number | null, agentType (from tool_input.subagent_type), description (from tool_input.description) }`. `endedAt: null` means still running — render as an open-ended bar, this IS the live view

Bonus finding to use, not deferred to a later depth layer: PostToolUse('Agent')'s payload already carries `tool_response.totalDurationMs`, `tool_response.totalTokens`, `tool_response.totalToolUseCount`, and `tool_response.agentType` — populate `durationMs`, `tokens`, `toolCallCount` on the closed bar record straight from these fields (no sidechain transcript parsing needed for MVP; that stays deferred to the PRD's 'depth layer' follow-up for per-turn sparklines/nested spawns)

Orphan-bar close-out: a bar whose PreToolUse arrived but whose matching PostToolUse never did (gateway restart, session killed) gets closed out when a `Stop` or `SessionEnd` event arrives for that session — set `endedAt` to that event's `ts` so no bar renders as running forever after the session is clearly over

Add unit tests in src/timeline/index.test.ts: a matched Pre/Post pair closes correctly with duration/tokens/toolCallCount populated; an unmatched Pre with no Post yields a running (`endedAt: null`) bar; a Stop event closes any still-open bars for that session
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Correlate agent bars against installed definitions and deliver them as a new Timeline row kind
userStories.description: As a user hovering an agent bar, I want to see the subagent's real identity (model, tools, description) from its installed definition, and as the UI, I want these bars delivered through the existing Timeline data path so no new endpoint or WS channel is needed.
acceptanceCriteria: New function correlates each bar's `agentType` (from US-002) against `readAgents(cwd)` (src/agents/index.ts:87) by matching `agentType` to `AgentEntry.name` — when there's a match, attach `{ model, tools, definitionDescription }` from that entry; when there's no match (e.g. a `fork` spawn, or a name that doesn't correspond to an installed .md file), leave those fields null rather than fabricating a value

Add a new `TimelineRow` variant with `kind: "agent"` (ui/src/components/Timeline.tsx:83+ union, mirrored in the gateway's row type in src/timeline/index.ts) carrying the full bar shape from US-002 plus the correlation fields from this story

Wire the derivation into `readTimeline()`/`buildTimeline()` (src/timeline/index.ts:653-694) the same way `skillsFired`/`plans` already are — no new gateway route; `GET /api/claude/timeline` (src/gateway/index.ts) starts returning `kind:"agent"` rows alongside the existing hook/skill/plan/build rows for sessions that have any Agent spawns

Live updates: confirm (write a short note in this story's notes/verification, don't add new broadcast logic) that a session's Agent PreToolUse/PostToolUse events already ride the existing WS `{type:'event'}` broadcast (src/gateway/index.ts:381) unchanged — the UI's job in US-004/US-005 is to re-derive bars client-side or re-fetch on that signal, not to expect a new dedicated broadcast type

Add unit tests in src/timeline/index.test.ts covering: correlation hit (agentType matches an installed definition fixture), correlation miss (agentType with no matching definition — fields stay null, no throw)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Live-update check (no new broadcast logic added): confirmed src/gateway/index.ts:381 `broadcast({ type: "event", payload: event })` fires unconditionally for every persisted hook event, including PreToolUse/PostToolUse where tool_name === "Agent" — no tool-name filtering exists on that path. The UI's job in US-004/US-005 is to re-derive bars client-side or re-fetch on that signal.

userStories.title: Build the AgentLanes.tsx waterfall component
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see subagent spawns as horizontal bars on a time axis — like Chrome DevTools' network panel — so I can tell at a glance how many agents are running, which is the straggler, and how long each took.
acceptanceCriteria: New component `ui/src/components/AgentLanes.tsx` (custom SVG/absolutely-positioned divs — no new npm dependency, matching the PRD's explicit rejection of a recharts-gantt hack and the project's existing hand-rolled-chart precedent)

Renders one lane/bar per `kind:"agent"` row (from US-003): bar position + width from `startedAt`/`endedAt` on a shared time axis; a still-running bar (`endedAt: null`) renders open-ended and visibly distinct (e.g. a subtle pulse/gradient) from a closed bar
Lane label reads `{agentType} · {description}` (e.g. 'skill-auditor · audit render-html'), truncated consistently with the rest of the Timeline's row-title truncation convention

Hovering a bar shows a card with: agent type, correlated `model`/`tools` (from US-003, when present — omit those lines gracefully when null instead of showing 'null'), spawn description, duration (`durationMs`, formatted with the existing `fmtDuration`-style helper already used elsewhere in the Usage widget), and token/tool-call totals when the bar is closed
Semantic theme tokens only (`bg-background`, `text-foreground`, `border-border`, etc.) — no hard-coded `neutral-*`/hex, matching CLAUDE.md conventions; correct in both light and dark
No new npm dependency added to ui/package.json
Typecheck passes

Verify in browser using automate-browser skill: render AgentLanes with at least one closed bar and one open-ended (running) bar (a small fixture/mock is fine for this story; live wiring is US-005) and screenshot both states
userStories.notes: Suggested skills: automate-browser. Wraps its own TooltipProvider (Timeline's existing provider only spans the classic row-list branch, which US-005 will swap out) so it works standalone wherever it's mounted. fmtDuration exported from Widgets.tsx to reuse the existing helper.
